question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
pred_sql:
WITH -- total runs per match+over (bat runs + extras)
over_runs AS (
  SELECT b.match_id,
         b.over_id,
         SUM(b.runs_scored) AS bat_runs,
         IFNULL((SELECT SUM(e.extra_runs) FROM extra_runs e WHERE e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id),0) AS extra_runs,
         (SUM(b.runs_scored) + IFNULL((SELECT SUM(e.extra_runs) FROM extra_runs e WHERE e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id),0)) AS total_runs_in_over
  FROM batsman_scored b
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
-- for each match find the maximum runs conceded in any over
match_max AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs_in_over) AS max_runs_in_match
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
-- identify overs that are the match-max overs
max_overs AS (
  SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.total_runs_in_over
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN match_max m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs_in_over = m.max_runs_in_match
),
-- find the bowler(s) who bowled those overs: determine bowler(s) present in that match+over in ball_by_ball
bowlers_in_max_overs AS (
  SELECT mo.match_id, mo.over_id, mo.total_runs_in_over, b.ball_id, b.bowler
  FROM max_overs mo
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON b.match_id = mo.match_id AND b.over_id = mo.over_id
),
-- aggregate distinct bowlers per match+over (some overs may have multiple bowlers recorded if data duplicated; keep unique)
distinct_bowlers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, over_id, total_runs_in_over, bowler
  FROM bowlers_in_max_overs
),
-- join to player to get bowler name
bowler_info AS (
  SELECT p.player_name AS bowler_name, d.bowler AS player_id, d.match_id, d.total_runs_in_over
  FROM distinct_bowlers d
  LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = d.bowler
)
-- final: pick top 3 by total_runs_in_over desc, if tie include all but limit to top 3 rows
SELECT bowler_name || COALESCE('', '') AS bowler_name,
       player_id,
       match_id,
       (SELECT match_date FROM "match" WHERE match.match_id = bowler_info.match_id) AS match_date,
       NULL AS overs_in_match,
       total_runs_in_over AS max_runs_in_any_over
FROM bowler_info
ORDER BY max_runs_in_any_over DESC, bowler_name
LIMIT 3

question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
pred_sql:
WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.bowler AS bowler_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(w.match_id || '-' || w.over_id || '-' || w.ball_id) AS wickets_taken
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
    ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_avg AS (
  SELECT
    bs.bowler_id,
    CASE WHEN bs.wickets_taken = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (CAST(bs.runs_conceded AS REAL) / bs.wickets_taken) END AS bowling_average
  FROM bowler_stats bs
)
SELECT p.player_name AS bowler_name, p.player_id AS bowler_id
FROM bowler_avg ba
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ba.bowler_id
WHERE ba.bowling_average = (
  SELECT MIN(bowling_average) FROM bowler_avg WHERE bowling_average IS NOT NULL
)
LIMIT 1
